title: RealmeUI Android 12.1 on Xiaomi 11T Pro Full ROM Review
blurb: RealmeUI RUI3 with Android 12.1, running on a Xiaomi 11T Pro — a full review of the port and whether it's more than a novelty.
video_description:
RealmeUI RUI3 with Android 12.1, running on a Xiaomi 11T Pro — a full review of the port and whether it's more than a novelty.

Cross branded ROMs are a strange kind of fun. RealmeUI on a Xiaomi device only exists because someone put in the work to port it, and the first thing you notice is how much of it is not Xiaomi. The interface changes, the settings layout changes, the whole tone of the software changes. On the 11T Pro the hardware can carry it, so the real question is whether the port behaves itself once the novelty wears off.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi MI 11T Pro (vili)
🧩 ROM     : RealmeUI RUI3 · Android 12.1
📦 Build   : updated 17/02/2023
